versos.grego: Ἀρχὴ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ (Υἱοῦ Θεοῦ).

controles.web: The beginning of the Good News of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.
controles.kjv: The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God;
controles.livre: Princípio do Evangelho de Jesus Cristo«, Filho de Deus».

versos.grego: Καθὼς γέγραπται ἐν τῷ Ἡσαΐᾳ τῷ προφήτῃ Ἰδοὺ ἀποστέλλω τὸν ἄγγελόν μου πρὸ προσώπου σου, ὃς κατασκευάσει τὴν ὁδόν σου·

controles.web: As it is written in the prophets,  “Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.
controles.kjv: As it is written in the prophets, Behold, I send my messenger before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.
controles.livre: Como está escrito no profeta Isaías:  Eis que eu envio o meu mensageiro diante de tua face, que preparará o teu caminho .

versos.grego: φωνὴ βοῶντος ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ Ἑτοιμάσατε τὴν ὁδὸν Κυρίου, εὐθείας ποιεῖτε τὰς τρίβους αὐτοῦ,

controles.web: The voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make ready the way of the Lord! Make his paths straight!’”
controles.kjv: The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make his paths straight.
controles.livre: Voz do que clama no deserto: Preparai o caminho do Senhor, endireitai suas veredas.

versos.grego: ἐγένετο Ἰωάνης ὁ βαπτίζων ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ κηρύσσων βάπτισμα μετανοίας εἰς ἄφεσιν ἁμαρτιῶν.

controles.web: John came baptizing in the wilderness and preaching the baptism of repentance for forgiveness of sins.
controles.kjv: John did baptize in the wilderness, and preach the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins.
controles.livre: João veio a batizar no deserto, e a pregar o batismo de arrependimento para perdão dos pecados.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐξεπορεύετο πρὸς αὐτὸν πᾶσα ἡ Ἰουδαία χώρα καὶ οἱ Ἱεροσολυμεῖται πάντες, καὶ ἐβαπτίζοντο ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ Ἰορδάνῃ ποταμῷ ἐξομολογούμενοι τὰς ἁμαρτίας αὐτῶν.

controles.web: All the country of Judea and all those of Jerusalem went out to him. They were baptized by him in the Jordan river, confessing their sins.
controles.kjv: And there went out unto him all the land of Judea, and they of Jerusalem, and were all baptized of him in the river of Jordan, confessing their sins.
controles.livre: E toda a província da Judeia e todos os de Jerusalém saíam até ele; e eram batizados por ele no rio Jordão, confessando os seus pecados.

versos.grego: καὶ ἦν ὁ Ἰωάνης ἐνδεδυμένος τρίχας καμήλου καὶ ζώνην δερματίνην περὶ τὴν ὀσφὺν αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἔσθων ἀκρίδας καὶ μέλι ἄγριον.

controles.web: John was clothed with camel’s hair and a leather belt around his waist. He ate locusts and wild honey.
controles.kjv: And John was clothed with camel’s hair, and with a girdle of a skin about his loins; and he did eat locusts and wild honey;
controles.livre: João se vestia de pelos de camelo, e um cinto de couro em sua cintura; e comia gafanhotos e mel do campo.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐκήρυσσεν λέγων Ἔρχεται ὁ ἰσχυρότερός μου ὀπίσω μου, οὗ οὐκ εἰμὶ ἱκανὸς κύψας λῦσαι τὸν ἱμάντα τῶν ὑποδημάτων αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: He preached, saying, “After me comes he who is mightier than I, the thong of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and loosen.
controles.kjv: And preached, saying, There cometh one mightier than I after me, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and unloose.
controles.livre: Ele pregava assim: Após mim vem aquele que é mais forte do que eu. A ele não sou digno de me abaixar para desatar a tira das suas sandálias.

versos.grego: ἐγὼ ἐβάπτισα ὑμᾶς ὕδατι, αὐτὸς δὲ βαπτίσει ὑμᾶς Πνεύματι Ἁγίῳ.

controles.web: I baptized you in water, but he will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.”
controles.kjv: I indeed have baptized you with water: but he shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost.
controles.livre: Eu tenho vos batizado com água, porém ele vos batizará com Espírito Santo.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν ἐκείναις ταῖς ἡμέραις ἦλθεν Ἰησοῦς ἀπὸ Ναζαρὲτ τῆς Γαλιλαίας καὶ ἐβαπτίσθη εἰς τὸν Ἰορδάνην ὑπὸ Ἰωάνου.

controles.web: In those days, Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized by John in the Jordan.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass in those days, that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized of John in Jordan.
controles.livre: E aconteceu que, naqueles dias, Jesus de Nazaré da Galileia veio, e foi batizado por João no Jordão.

versos.grego: καὶ εὐθὺς ἀναβαίνων ἐκ τοῦ ὕδατος εἶδεν σχιζομένους τοὺς οὐρανοὺς καὶ τὸ Πνεῦμα ὡς περιστερὰν καταβαῖνον εἰς αὐτόν·

controles.web: Immediately coming up from the water, he saw the heavens parting, and the Spirit descending on him like a dove.
controles.kjv: And straightway coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens opened, and the Spirit like a dove descending upon him:
controles.livre: E assim que saiu da água, viu os céus se abrirem, e o Espírito, que como pomba descia sobre ele.

versos.grego: καὶ φωνὴ ἐγένετο ἐκ τῶν οὐρανῶν Σὺ εἶ ὁ Υἱός μου ὁ ἀγαπητός, ἐν σοὶ εὐδόκησα.

controles.web: A voice came out of the sky, “You are my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”
controles.kjv: And there came a voice from heaven, saying, Thou art my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.
controles.livre: E veio uma voz dos céus: Tu és meu Filho amado, em ti me agrado.

versos.grego: Καὶ εὐθὺς τὸ Πνεῦμα αὐτὸν ἐκβάλλει εἰς τὴν ἔρημον.

controles.web: Immediately the Spirit drove him out into the wilderness.
controles.kjv: And immediately the Spirit driveth him into the wilderness.
controles.livre: E logo o Espírito o impeliu ao deserto.

versos.grego: καὶ ἦν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ τεσσεράκοντα ἡμέρας πειραζόμενος ὑπὸ τοῦ Σατανᾶ, καὶ ἦν μετὰ τῶν θηρίων, καὶ οἱ ἄγγελοι διηκόνουν αὐτῷ.

controles.web: He was there in the wilderness forty days tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals; and the angels were serving him.
controles.kjv: And he was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted of Satan; and was with the wild beasts; and the angels ministered unto him.
controles.livre: Ele esteve no deserto quarenta dias, tentado por Satanás. Ele estava com os animais selvagens, e os anjos o serviam.

versos.grego: Καὶ μετὰ τὸ παραδοθῆναι τὸν Ἰωάνην ἦλθεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν κηρύσσων τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Θεοῦ

controles.web: Now after John was taken into custody, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the Good News of the Kingdom of God,
controles.kjv: Now after that John was put in prison, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the gospel of the kingdom of God,
controles.livre: Depois que João foi preso, Jesus veio para a Galileia, pregando o Evangelho de Deus,

versos.grego: καὶ λέγων ὅτι Πεπλήρωται ὁ καιρὸς καὶ ἤγγικεν ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Θεοῦ· μετανοεῖτε καὶ πιστεύετε ἐν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ.

controles.web: and saying, “The time is fulfilled, and the Kingdom of God is at hand! Repent, and believe in the Good News.”
controles.kjv: And saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent ye, and believe the gospel.
controles.livre: e dizendo: O tempo se cumpriu, e o Reino de Deus está perto; arrependei-vos, e crede no Evangelho.

versos.grego: Καὶ παράγων παρὰ τὴν θάλασσαν τῆς Γαλιλαίας εἶδεν Σίμωνα καὶ Ἀνδρέαν τὸν ἀδελφὸν Σίμωνος ἀμφιβάλλοντας ἐν τῇ θαλάσσῃ· ἦσαν γὰρ ἁλεεῖς.

controles.web: Passing along by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew the brother of Simon casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.
controles.kjv: Now as he walked by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew his brother casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers.
controles.livre: E enquanto andava junto ao mar da Galileia, ele viu Simão e seu irmão André, que lançavam uma rede ao mar, porque eram pescadores;

versos.grego: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Δεῦτε ὀπίσω μου, καὶ ποιήσω ὑμᾶς γενέσθαι ἁλεεῖς ἀνθρώπων.

controles.web: Jesus said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you into fishers for men.”
controles.kjv: And Jesus said unto them, Come ye after me, and I will make you to become fishers of men.
controles.livre: Jesus lhes disse: Vinde após mim, e farei serdes pescadores de gente.

versos.grego: καὶ εὐθὺς ἀφέντες τὰ δίκτυα ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ.

controles.web: Immediately they left their nets, and followed him.
controles.kjv: And straightway they forsook their nets, and followed him.
controles.livre: Então logo deixaram as redes, e o seguiram.

versos.grego: Καὶ προβὰς ὀλίγον εἶδεν Ἰάκωβον τὸν τοῦ Ζεβεδαίου καὶ Ἰωάνην τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ, καὶ αὐτοὺς ἐν τῷ πλοίῳ καταρτίζοντας τὰ δίκτυα,

controles.web: Going on a little further from there, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John, his brother, who were also in the boat mending the nets.
controles.kjv: And when he had gone a little further thence, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also were in the ship mending their nets.
controles.livre: E passando um pouco mais adiante, viu Tiago filho de Zebedeu, e seu irmão João, que estavam no barco, consertando as redes.

versos.grego: καὶ εὐθὺς ἐκάλεσεν αὐτούς· καὶ ἀφέντες τὸν πατέρα αὐτῶν Ζεβεδαῖον ἐν τῷ πλοίῳ μετὰ τῶν μισθωτῶν ἀπῆλθον ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: Immediately he called them, and they left their father, Zebedee, in the boat with the hired servants, and went after him.
controles.kjv: And straightway he called them: and they left their father Zebedee in the ship with the hired servants, and went after him.
controles.livre: E logo os chamou; então eles deixaram o seu pai Zebedeu no barco com os empregados, foram após ele.

versos.grego: Καὶ εἰσπορεύονται εἰς Καφαρναούμ· καὶ εὐθὺς τοῖς σάββασιν εἰσελθὼν εἰς τὴν συναγωγὴν ἐδίδασκεν.

controles.web: They went into Capernaum, and immediately on the Sabbath day he entered into the synagogue and taught.
controles.kjv: And they went into Capernaum; and straightway on the sabbath day he entered into the synagogue, and taught.
controles.livre: Eles entraram em Cafarnaum; e assim que chegou o sábado, Jesus entrou na sinagoga e começou a ensinar.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐξεπλήσσοντο ἐπὶ τῇ διδαχῇ αὐτοῦ· ἦν γὰρ διδάσκων αὐτοὺς ὡς ἐξουσίαν ἔχων, καὶ οὐχ ὡς οἱ γραμματεῖς.

controles.web: They were astonished at his teaching, for he taught them as having authority, and not as the scribes.
controles.kjv: And they were astonished at his doctrine: for he taught them as one that had authority, and not as the scribes.
controles.livre: E ficavam admirados com o seu ensinamento, pois, diferentemente dos escribas, ele os ensinava como quem temautoridade.

versos.grego: Καὶ εὐθὺς ἦν ἐν τῇ συναγωγῇ αὐτῶν ἄνθρωπος ἐν πνεύματι ἀκαθάρτῳ, καὶ ἀνέκραξεν

controles.web: Immediately there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit, and he cried out,
controles.kjv: And there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit; and he cried out,
controles.livre: E logo apareceu na sinagoga deles um homem com um espírito imundo, que gritou,

versos.grego: λέγων Τί ἡμῖν καὶ σοί, Ἰησοῦ Ναζαρηνέ; ἦλθες ἀπολέσαι ἡμᾶς. οἶδά σε τίς εἶ, ὁ Ἅγιος τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: saying, “Ha! What do we have to do with you, Jesus, you Nazarene? Have you come to destroy us? I know you who you are: the Holy One of God!”
controles.kjv: Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with thee, thou Jesus of Nazareth? art thou come to destroy us? I know thee who thou art, the Holy One of God.
controles.livre: dizendo: Ah, que temos contigo, Jesus Nazareno? Vieste para nos destruir? Bem sei quem és: o Santo de Deus.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐπετίμησεν αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Φιμώθητι καὶ ἔξελθε ἐξ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be quiet, and come out of him!”
controles.kjv: And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold thy peace, and come out of him.
controles.livre: Jesus o repreendeu, dizendo: Cala-te, e sai dele.

versos.grego: καὶ σπαράξαν αὐτὸν τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἀκάθαρτον καὶ φωνῆσαν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ ἐξῆλθεν ἐξ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: The unclean spirit, convulsing him and crying with a loud voice, came out of him.
controles.kjv: And when the unclean spirit had torn him, and cried with a loud voice, he came out of him.
controles.livre: E o espírito imundo, provocando convulsão nele, e gritando em alta voz, saiu dele.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐθαμβήθησαν ἅπαντες, ὥστε συνζητεῖν αὐτοὺς λέγοντας Τί ἐστιν τοῦτο; διδαχὴ καινή κατ’ ἐξουσίαν· καὶ τοῖς πνεύμασι τοῖς ἀκαθάρτοις ἐπιτάσσει, καὶ ὑπακούουσιν αὐτῷ.

controles.web: They were all amazed, so that they questioned among themselves, saying, “What is this? A new teaching? For with authority he commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey him!”
controles.kjv: And they were all amazed, insomuch that they questioned among themselves, saying, What thing is this? what new doctrine is this? for with authority commandeth he even the unclean spirits, and they do obey him.
controles.livre: Assim todos ficaram admirados, e perguntavam entre si: Que é isto? Que novo ensinamento com autoridade! Ele ordena até aos espíritos imundos, e eles lhe obedecem!

versos.grego: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἡ ἀκοὴ αὐτοῦ εὐθὺς πανταχοῦ εἰς ὅλην τὴν περίχωρον τῆς Γαλιλαίας.

controles.web: The report of him went out immediately everywhere into all the region of Galilee and its surrounding area.
controles.kjv: And immediately his fame spread abroad throughout all the region round about Galilee.
controles.livre: E logo sua fama se espalhou por toda a região da Galileia.

versos.grego: Καὶ εὐθὺς ἐκ τῆς συναγωγῆς ἐξελθόντες ἦλθον εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν Σίμωνος καὶ Ἀνδρέου μετὰ Ἰακώβου καὶ Ἰωάνου.

controles.web: Immediately, when they had come out of the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.
controles.kjv: And forthwith, when they were come out of the synagogue, they entered into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.
controles.livre: Logo depois de saírem da sinagoga, vieram à casa de Simão e de André, com Tiago e João.

versos.grego: ἡ δὲ πενθερὰ Σίμωνος κατέκειτο πυρέσσουσα, καὶ εὐθὺς λέγουσιν αὐτῷ περὶ αὐτῆς.

controles.web: Now Simon’s wife’s mother lay sick with a fever, and immediately they told him about her.
controles.kjv: But Simon’s wife’s mother lay sick of a fever, and anon they tell him of her.
controles.livre: A sogra de Simão estava deitada com febre, e logo falaram dela a Jesus .

versos.grego: καὶ προσελθὼν ἤγειρεν αὐτὴν κρατήσας τῆς χειρός· καὶ ἀφῆκεν αὐτὴν ὁ πυρετός, καὶ διηκόνει αὐτοῖς.

controles.web: He came and took her by the hand, and raised her up. The fever left her, and she served them.
controles.kjv: And he came and took her by the hand, and lifted her up; and immediately the fever left her, and she ministered unto them.
controles.livre: Então ele aproximou-se dela, tomou-a pela mão, e a levantou; logo a febre a deixou, e ela começou a servi-los.

versos.grego: Ὀψίας δὲ γενομένης, ὅτε ἔδυσεν ὁ ἥλιος, ἔφερον πρὸς αὐτὸν πάντας τοὺς κακῶς ἔχοντας καὶ τοὺς δαιμονιζομένους·

controles.web: At evening, when the sun had set, they brought to him all who were sick, and those who were possessed by demons.
controles.kjv: And at even, when the sun did set, they brought unto him all that were diseased, and them that were possessed with devils.
controles.livre: Ao entardecer, quando o sol já se punha, trouxeram-lhe todos os doentes e endemoninhados;

versos.grego: καὶ ἦν ὅλη ἡ πόλις ἐπισυνηγμένη πρὸς τὴν θύραν.

controles.web: All the city was gathered together at the door.
controles.kjv: And all the city was gathered together at the door.
controles.livre: e toda a cidade se juntou à porta.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐθεράπευσεν πολλοὺς κακῶς ἔχοντας ποικίλαις νόσοις, καὶ δαιμόνια πολλὰ ἐξέβαλεν, καὶ οὐκ ἤφιεν λαλεῖν τὰ δαιμόνια, ὅτι ᾔδεισαν αὐτόν.

controles.web: He healed many who were sick with various diseases, and cast out many demons. He didn’t allow the demons to speak, because they knew him.
controles.kjv: And he healed many that were sick of divers diseases, and cast out many devils; and suffered not the devils to speak, because they knew him.
controles.livre: Ele curou muitos que se achavam mal de diversas enfermidades, e expulsou muitos demônios. Ele não deixava os demônios falarem, porque o conheciam.

versos.grego: Καὶ πρωῒ ἔννυχα λίαν ἀναστὰς ἐξῆλθεν καὶ ἀπῆλθεν εἰς ἔρημον τόπον, κἀκεῖ προσηύχετο.

controles.web: Early in the morning, while it was still dark, he rose up and went out, and departed into a deserted place, and prayed there.
controles.kjv: And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out, and departed into a solitary place, and there prayed.
controles.livre: De madrugada, ainda escuro, ele se levantou para sair, foi a um lugar deserto, e ali esteve a orar.

versos.grego: καὶ κατεδίωξεν αὐτὸν Σίμων καὶ οἱ μετ’ αὐτοῦ,

controles.web: Simon and those who were with him followed after him;
controles.kjv: And Simon and they that were with him followed after him.
controles.livre: Simão e os que estavam com ele o seguiram.

versos.grego: καὶ εὗρον αὐτὸν καὶ λέγουσιν αὐτῷ ὅτι Πάντες ζητοῦσίν σε.

controles.web: and they found him, and told him, “Everyone is looking for you.”
controles.kjv: And when they had found him, they said unto him, All men seek for thee.
controles.livre: Quando o acharam, disseram-lhe: Todos estão te procurando.

versos.grego: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς· Ἄγωμεν ἀλλαχοῦ εἰς τὰς ἐχομένας κωμοπόλεις, ἵνα καὶ ἐκεῖ κηρύξω· εἰς τοῦτο γὰρ ἐξῆλθον.

controles.web: He said to them, “Let’s go elsewhere into the next towns, that I may preach there also, because I came out for this reason.”
controles.kjv: And he said unto them, Let us go into the next towns, that I may preach there also: for therefore came I forth.
controles.livre: Jesus lhes respondeu: Vamos para as aldeias vizinhas, para que eu também pregue ali, pois vim para isso.

versos.grego: καὶ ἦλθεν κηρύσσων εἰς τὰς συναγωγὰς αὐτῶν εἰς ὅλην τὴν Γαλιλαίαν καὶ τὰ δαιμόνια ἐκβάλλων.

controles.web: He went into their synagogues throughout all Galilee, preaching and casting out demons.
controles.kjv: And he preached in their synagogues throughout all Galilee, and cast out devils.
controles.livre: Ele foi pregar em suas sinagogas por toda a Galileia, e expulsava os demônios.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἔρχεται πρὸς αὐτὸν λεπρὸς παρακαλῶν αὐτὸν καὶ γονυπετῶν λέγων αὐτῷ ὅτι Ἐὰν θέλῃς δύνασαί με καθαρίσαι.

controles.web: A leper came to him, begging him, kneeling down to him, and saying to him, “If you want to, you can make me clean.”
controles.kjv: And there came a leper to him, beseeching him, and kneeling down to him, and saying unto him, If thou wilt, thou canst make me clean.
controles.livre: Um leproso aproximou-se dele, rogando-lhe, pondo-se de joelhos , e dizendo-lhe: Se quiseres, tu podes limpar-me.

versos.grego: καὶ σπλαγχνισθεὶς ἐκτείνας τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ ἥψατο καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ Θέλω, καθαρίσθητι.

controles.web: Being moved with compassion, he stretched out his hand, and touched him, and said to him, “I want to. Be made clean.”
controles.kjv: And Jesus, moved with compassion, put forth his hand, and touched him, and saith unto him, I will; be thou clean.
controles.livre: E Jesus , movido de compaixão, estendeu a mão, tocou-o, e disse-lhe: Quero; sê limpo.

versos.grego: καὶ εὐθὺς ἀπῆλθεν ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ἡ λέπρα, καὶ ἐκαθερίσθη.

controles.web: When he had said this, immediately the leprosy departed from him, and he was made clean.
controles.kjv: And as soon as he had spoken, immediately the leprosy departed from him, and he was cleansed.
controles.livre: Logo a lepra saiu dele, e ficou limpo.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐμβριμησάμενος αὐτῷ εὐθὺς ἐξέβαλεν αὐτόν,

controles.web: He strictly warned him, and immediately sent him out,
controles.kjv: And he straitly charged him, and forthwith sent him away;
controles.livre: Jesus advertiu-o, e logo o despediu,

versos.grego: καὶ λέγει αὐτῷ Ὅρα μηδενὶ μηδὲν εἴπῃς, ἀλλὰ ὕπαγε σεαυτὸν δεῖξον τῷ ἱερεῖ καὶ προσένεγκε περὶ τοῦ καθαρισμοῦ σου ἃ προσέταξεν Μωϋσῆς εἰς μαρτύριον αὐτοῖς.

controles.web: and said to him, “See you say nothing to anybody, but go show yourself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing the things which Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”
controles.kjv: And saith unto him, See thou say nothing to any man: but go thy way, shew thyself to the priest, and offer for thy cleansing those things which Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them.
controles.livre: dizendo-lhe: Cuidado, não digas nada a ninguém. Mas vai, mostra-te ao Sacerdote, e oferece por teres ficado limpo o que Moisés mandou, para lhes servir de testemunho.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ ἐξελθὼν ἤρξατο κηρύσσειν πολλὰ καὶ διαφημίζειν τὸν λόγον, ὥστε μηκέτι αὐτὸν δύνασθαι φανερῶς εἰς πόλιν εἰσελθεῖν, ἀλλ’ ἔξω ἐπ’ ἐρήμοις τόποις ἦν· καὶ ἤρχοντο πρὸς αὐτὸν πάντοθεν.

controles.web: But he went out, and began to proclaim it much, and to spread about the matter, so that Jesus could no more openly enter into a city, but was outside in desert places: and they came to him from everywhere.
controles.kjv: But he went out, and began to publish it much, and to blaze abroad the matter, insomuch that Jesus could no more openly enter into the city, but was without in desert places: and they came to him from every quarter.
controles.livre: Porém, quando ele saiu, começou a anunciar muitas coisas, e a divulgar a notícia, de maneira que Jesus já não podia entrar publicamente na cidade; em vez disso, ficava do lado de fora em lugares desertos, e pessoas de todas as partes vinham até ele.
